provenance.paper_title: MGA: Memory-Driven GUI Agent for Observation-Centric Interaction

evidence.section: Full paper: MGA: Memory-Driven GUI Agent for Observation-Centric Interaction
evidence.paraphrase: Each decision uses the current screenshot, task-agnostic spatial information, and dynamically updated structured memory.
During operation, MGA applies LLM-mediated memory editing to dynamic observation-centric structured memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, MGA applies episodic or hierarchical summarization to dynamic observation-centric structured memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

evidence.section: Full paper: MGA: Memory-Driven GUI Agent for Observation-Centric Interaction
evidence.paraphrase: Independent context-rich state records limit propagation of stale trajectory errors. For MGA, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of dynamic observation-centric structured memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 10): During inference, the operative memory component (dynamic observation-centric structured memory) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, episodic or hierarchical summarization, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
